comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One polygon, way/528965906 (Telluride Ski Area): the town side above Telluride, Mountain Village, Prospect Bowl, Gold Hill, Palmyra Peak, Black Iron Bowl and Revelation Bowl on one ticket and one map; no other ski area lies in the box or the Overpass window. Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-10 against the resort's current trail map (tellurideskiresort.com/mountain, 2425_TSR_Trail-Map_layered-trailmap.pdf, the James Niehues painting, the 2024-25 edition the page still links; its labels are vector outlines with no text layer, so it was rendered at four and eight times its size and read tile by tile) and the page's two detail maps for the hike-to terrain the main map points to ('See Reverse for Detail': palmyra-23.24.png for Palmyra Peak, the Gold Hill Chutes and Black Iron Bowl, revvy-23.24-1.png for Revelation Bowl). The legend has five grades: easiest (one or two green dots), more difficult (one or two blue squares), most difficult (one black diamond), most difficult expert only (two) and EX, extreme. The resort's snow report loads its trail list by script, so the printed maps are the only source and win. OSM's easy, intermediate, advanced and expert match the first four, and EX is OSM's extreme (as Breckenridge's and Keystone's Extreme Terrain); of the 133 named OSM runs, the ones the maps print carry their rating but 28 ways. Ratings from the maps: the 24 EX runs OSM rates expert become extreme (Electra, Dynamo, Millions and Andy's Gold under the Revelation Lift; Gold Hill 1, 2 and 6 to 10; Roy Boy, Senior's, Tram Shot, Sunrise, Electric Shock, Capitol, Nice Chute, Review, Jello's Bowl and Zipper Rock on Palmyra Peak; Dihedral Chute, Dihedral Face and Westlake in Black Iron Bowl); Spiral Stairs, two ways of West Drain and a 7 m piece of Lower Plunge, two diamonds on the map, advanced in OSM, become expert; the last stretch of Lower Galloping Goose to the Meadows base, green on the map, gets easy (one way unrated in OSM, three named Galloping Goose Ski Run and rated intermediate by the town's nordic network, which shares them). Names from the map: Humboldt Draw (OSM Humbolt), Double Cabin (OSM Double Cabins), Woozley's Way for a 75 m piece OSM spells Wozzley's, and Free Gondola, the map's label on all three gondola segments (OSM Gondola Line 1 and 2 between the town and Mountain Village by San Sophia Station, and Free Intercept Gondola from Mountain Village to Market Plaza). The free gondola is kept as lifts: skiers ride it, it is the town side's way up and down, and San Sophia Station is a top station the map draws runs from. Names that differ from the map only by a space, an article or punctuation stay as OSM has them (Bailout for BAIL OUT, Logpile for LOG PILE, Silvertip for SILVER TIP, Holy Cow for HOLY COW!, The Plunge for PLUNGE); runs OSM names and the maps do not print stay (Lower Happy Thought below the Polar Queen Express top, Headwall at the town base, Magnolia Headwall, and Easy Chute, Way Easy, Snowslide Cabin and Pee-Wee's Big Adventure among the Palmyra and Black Iron Bowl lines). Bail Out is black above its junction beside the Oak Street Lift and blue below on the map, as OSM rates its pieces. Parks: Hoot Brown Terrain Park, which the map draws orange beside the Village Express, gets the park flag. Lifts: all of the map's are in OSM (Chondola 1, Comp Hill 2, Village Express 4, Polar Queen Express 5, Apex Lift 6, Lift 7, Oak Street Lift 8, Plunge Lift 9, Sunshine Express 10, Ute Park 11, Prospect Express 12, Lynx 13, Gold Hill Express 14, Revelation Lift 15, the free gondola and two carpets), none hidden. OSM gaps (shipped as at Palisades Tahoe): Giant Steps, Silver Glade and Chongos beside the Apex Lift, Buzz's Glade (EX) below Tempter House, Stormin' Norman, Dew Drop Drain and Nastar on the Polar Queen and Village Express sides, Lower Lookout, Heritage Trail and Grouse Glade at the Sunshine Express bottom, Golden Cross in Revelation Bowl, the Gold Hill Chutes 3 to 5 (closed on the map), the Beginner Park beside the Ute Park lift and the Goat Path traverse.
